The ignored-SIGTERM fixture patches the module global TERMINATION_GRACE_SECONDS to .15, but measure's default parameter was captured as 5 seconds when defined and run_control does not pass an override.

independent_findings.finding: The ignored-SIGTERM child has no readiness handshake confirming SIG_IGN installation. Even a spawned child must complete interpreter startup and handler installation before the original 200 ms deadline for this intended branch.
independent_findings.scope: Fixture reachability assumption; does not authorize a deadline reset.

independent_findings.finding: The existing five-second late-observed-exit-zero control passed in this original 32-method command.

recommendation.decision: A single predeclared isolated full 32-method follow-up on unchanged C6 is reasonable.
recommendation.wait_until: All known parallel Cargo/whole-source I/O original jobs, the separately declared backend follow-up and receiver have reached terminal before the isolated suite.
recommendation.reuse: Same original recorded argv, cwd, interpreter/environment, C6 bytes and fixture parameters; preserve actual default cleanup grace. Fresh output directory only; do not alter TMPDIR/storage class or process constraints silently.
no_changes: No widening the 0.15/0.20-second fixture wall budgets
No clock substitution or added mocked success
recommendation.success_rule: Exactly all 32 methods execute with zero failures/errors/skips; retain raw logs, independent source-before/after and authoritative terminal. Report isolated follow-up success separately from the failed original attempt.
recommendation.on_failure: Retain the failed follow-up and leave the intended controls unresolved; diagnose or propose a separately identified fixture revision before further qualification.
recommendation.counting: Do not sum repeated methods into a larger unique-control denominator, or rewrite the first 30-pass/2-fail command or eventual original core terminal as PASS.

source_change_judgment.future_narrow_fixture_issue: Any later test revision should make the intended post-spawn/readiness and cleanup-grace parameters explicit while retaining separate genuine no-spawn deadline coverage; new bytes require a new source identity and controls. Do not implement this as acceptance of either reason or merely reset the original deadline.
